# Limits and budgets

Hard limits and budgets, collected from the MAX_*/MIN_* constants in src/ (values are evaluated from the source, so they are current). Exceeding a limit is rejected with a diagnostic (usually BUDGET_EXCEEDED, IMPORT_LIMIT or INVALID_VALUE), never silently clamped, unless the meaning says otherwise. Time is in ticks: 60 ticks = 1 second. Per-parameter ranges (Emitter burst <= 4096, rate <= 4096, speed <= 100 m/s...) are listed with each node in nodes.md, not here. A constant defined in several files (for example MAX_DURATION_TICKS) has the same value everywhere.

## Headline limits

The ones that matter most when building effects.

| limit | value | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| Live particles at once | 30000 default; configurable 1–65536 | Set Controls → Effect settings → Live particle budget, or root EffectOutput.particleBudget through MCP. Peak checked across all systems at compile. |
| Particles born per effect | 65536 | Total births over the whole effect. |
| Burst events per emitter | 1024 | Trigger events considered by one emitter. |
| Effect duration | 600 ticks (10 s) | Minimum 1 tick; longer is rejected. |
| Active lights | 4 | PointLights drawn at once in the preview. |
| Paths per tick / branches | 256 / 64 | Beam/bolt/ring paths evaluated per tick; BranchPath branch count cap. |
| Mesh pieces / triangles per frame | 512 / 250000 | Preview MeshRenderer budget. |
| Roblox export mesh pieces | 300 | Parts one export may animate. |
| Imported texture | 16 MiB, 4096 px per side | Larger is rejected with IMPORT_LIMIT. |
| Imported GLB mesh | 20 MiB, 50000 triangles, 8 materials, 16 primitives | Self-contained GLB 2.0 only; larger is rejected with IMPORT_LIMIT. |
| Document JSON | 5 MiB | Larger files are rejected before parsing. |
